facts.fact: Starlink began operations in Somalia after regulatory approval from the National Communications Authority in April 2025.

Starlink's satellite internet rolled out in Somalia in August 2025, and in September 2025 AstaanConnect was named the first official Starlink reseller offering sales, installation and support to households, businesses and government offices.

note: The 10.7 million internet-user figure is government data on all internet users, not satellite subscribers.
